topic: Which breathtaking landmark would you explore?

files.name: 01.png
files.label: THE BASALT WATERFALL
files.must_show: A large waterfall landmark is centered between tall dark basalt rock columns.
files.observed_subject: A broad white waterfall drops into a rocky pool between tall dark basalt columns with mountains behind.

files.name: 02.png
files.label: THE SUNSET AQUEDUCT
files.must_show: A large stone aqueduct landmark with multiple arches dominates the scene above a river.
files.observed_subject: A large old stone aqueduct with several high arches crosses a turquoise gorge under a warm sunset.

files.name: 03.png
files.label: THE HIGHLAND CASTLE
files.must_show: A large medieval castle landmark with many towers rises behind its stone gatehouse.
files.observed_subject: A large multi-towered stone castle rises behind a fortified gatehouse and wooden drawbridge, with a waterfall at the right.

files.name: 04.png
files.label: THE GOLDEN PORTAL
files.must_show: A monumental carved stone portal landmark with two open bronze doors fills the center.
files.observed_subject: An enormous freestanding carved stone arch and two open bronze doors frame a sunlit mountain valley.

files.name: 05.png
files.label: THE MOUNTAIN VIADUCT
files.must_show: A tall multi-arched railway viaduct landmark dominates the gorge, with a red train above.
files.observed_subject: A high multi-arched stone railway viaduct carries a red steam train over a steep green mountain gorge.
